item.title: Constructing an Approximate Time-line of Mahaprabhu’s Life Events in Gregorian Calendar
item.description: By Khonika Gope We all know that Mahaprabhu was born on February 18, 1486. Other than these broad chronologies, we know very little about the exact timelines of His life events. The difficulty in constructing a reliable timeline of His life events lies in the fact that the years of most of those events are hardly recorded.
